outcome: The organization has a researched, implementation-ready design for an evidence-gated HOW-evolution loop that consumes durable causal observation, evaluates a pinned baseline against a pinned candidate under fixed work semantics, integrates Jev as an independently identifiable evaluator in the pipeline, and permits promotion or rollback only through separate currentness-fenced authority without changing accepted product truth.
currentProblem: The repository already has Core evaluation/trust primitives, a deterministic application evaluation gate, a bounded self-upgrade pilot, durable execution-policy/strategy binding, and Integration I causal observation. These pieces are not yet composed into one production organization-level evaluation pipeline: Jev currently judges the outer Blackboard delivery process, while the internal system lacks a contract that turns causal findings into bounded HOW candidates, evaluates them with authenticated evidence/evaluator identity, and safely promotes a new ExecutionPolicy/ExecutionStrategy version without self-acceptance or moving WHAT/product semantics.
constraints: Jev may produce evaluation evidence/judgment but cannot itself become product acceptance, root authority, work scheduler or automatic promotion authority.

HOW evolution may change versioned execution strategy/policy/context/tool/model/harness configuration only; accepted WHAT, WorkContract semantics and product acceptance requirements remain fixed for the evaluated subject.
Baseline, candidate, evaluator identity/policy, scenario set, evidence inputs and semantic subject are immutable and pinned before evaluation.
Observation from Integration I is evidence input only; causal observation cannot authorize candidate generation, promotion, rollback or product currentness changes.
Promotion is a separate independently authorized action that publishes a new immutable current policy/strategy generation through existing CAS/currentness semantics.
Existing ACTIVE/RECOVERY_REQUIRED attempts remain pinned to their original ExecutionAttemptBinding; a promoted HOW version affects only eligible new attempts.
Evaluation/currentness drift fails closed: changed work semantics, acceptance policy, protocol, evaluator policy or relevant evidence requires re-evaluation before promotion.
Failed, inconclusive or unauthorized evaluation keeps the accepted baseline current.
Rollback preserves history and publishes an explicit successor policy/version referencing the exact previously accepted baseline rather than rewriting prior artifacts.
No generic optimizer, autonomous self-modifying runtime, organization-wide experiment platform or product-truth mutation is required.
successCriteria: A fixed evaluation protocol can compare one pinned baseline and one pinned HOW candidate for the same semantic work/acceptance subject using exact causal/runtime evidence and an authenticated evaluator identity.
Jev integration has an explicit adapter/contract: its input, output, policy identity, evidence refs, freshness rules and trust verification are durable and independently checkable.
A candidate producer cannot evaluate or promote its own candidate, and a Jev PASS alone cannot mutate ExecutionPolicy, ProductHistory, QualityAcceptance or ProductOutcome currentness.
PASS may produce an independently reviewable promotion proposal; FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE, stale evidence or authority mismatch deterministically keeps the baseline.

An accepted promotion creates a new immutable ExecutionPolicy/ExecutionStrategy version for the exact domain/workload scope, while an already-bound in-flight/recovery attempt continues using its old binding.
Promotion racing with changed semantics, acceptance/evaluator policy or evidence currentness fails closed and requires a fresh evaluation.
Rollback creates a new auditable policy generation pointing to the exact accepted baseline and preserves the candidate/evaluation/promotion history.
A fresh process can reconstruct baseline, candidate, evaluator/policy, evidence, decision, promotion/rollback authority and resulting current policy from durable refs without conversation history.
